title: 1 BHK in Mumbai = Villa in Dubai? Don't Buy Property in India.
description:

Important for Home Buyers
Before buying any ready or under-construction property, always verify:
 • RERA registration
 • Legal approvals
 • Possession timelines
Simple explanation of RERA here (optional):🔗 https://www.basichomeloan.com/blog/home-loans/what-is-rera

Most people believe:  “अगर पैसा है, तो घर मिल जाएगा”
But honestly, the reality in India is very different.
In this video, I’ve tried to explain why buying a home today is not just about having money, but about understanding the system.
We talk about things like:
 • Why even after having ₹1–2 crore, buying a home is still difficult
 • Circle rate vs actual market value of property
 • Why banks reject home loans even when people look eligible on paper
 • How stamp duty, income tax, and cash components affect property deals
 • Why many “ready” or “under-construction” projects never get delivered
 • How illegal societies and non-RERA projects put buyers at risk
 • Why affordability is actually the biggest real estate problem in India
As per reports, 44%+ property transactions in India involve cash  Many cities are officially marked “unaffordable” Yet, we still see oversupply — flats without real buyers
This video is not meant to scare anyone. It’s about understanding the system before putting your life savings at risk.
If You’re Exploring a Home Loan
When the system is this complicated, right guidance matters more than flashy interest-rate ads.
If you’re looking for clarity, BASIC Home Loan is one option you can check out.
They work as an independent home-loan advisor and help buyers by:
 • Comparing options from 150+ banks & NBFCs
 • Explaining your actual loan eligibility
 • Helping you understand bank valuation vs circle rate
 • Avoiding unnecessary add-ons like forced insurance
Their advisory is free for customers (they earn from lenders, not borrowers).
You can explore options here:https://www.basichomeloan.com/?qrid=BAE001MDT&utm_source=Influencer&utm_medium=Marketing&utm_campaign=genzway
Important Tip (Please Don’t Skip)
Before buying any ready or under-construction property:
 • Always check RERA registration
 • Verify legal approvals, timelines, and possession status
Simple explanation of RERA here: https://www.basichomeloan.com/blog/home-loans/what-is-rera
Final Thought
Don’t rush into buying a home just because:“Price will increase” or “Everyone is buying”.
First, understand the system.Then take a decision that won’t trap you for the next 20–30 years.
